t: You're on Palace Gate, a street just south of Kensington Gardens. It was once part of Gloucester Road, and it was first developed in the 1860s. The painter Sir John Everett Millais died here. He was a child prodigy, who at eleven became the youngest student ever admitted to the Royal Academy Schools. He was also a founder of the Pre-Raphaelite Brotherhood, and his painting Ophelia, from 1851 and 1852, is often held up as the group's finest expression of its ideals.
